Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Gaurav Pawar. I am a 67-year-old government clerk living in Pune. M/s Sterling Traders gave me a cheque for Rs 22,10,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque was returned unpaid for insufficient funds. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 69625 03203 or email gaurav.pawar@example.in.
